name: – Nils Ušakovs – After § 50 – Am 53
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 50a. Calls for the EU-Israel Association Agreement to be suspended, bearing in mind the prerogatives the agreement contains, following Israel’s brutal aggression and genocide against the Palestinian people; calls for the cancellation of Horizon 2020 funds that could be used in military or dual-use projects;
